evals.prompt: Create a Maintainfile.md for this GitHub-hosted TypeScript service. It uses Dependabot, Vitest, generated API docs, and a weekly database backup job. Inspect the repository and do not add generic processes that do not apply.
evals.expected_output: A repository-root Maintainfile.md containing concrete recurring processes grounded in the observed dependency, test, documentation, and backup systems.
expectations: The agent inspects repository evidence before writing the file.
Every active process has an owner, cadence or trigger, evidence, a read-only check, a healthy condition, and remediation guidance.
The file contains no credentials and no speculative maintenance catalog.

evals.prompt: /maintainance run. Check everything in Maintainfile.md and give me the starting point for a remediation plan, but do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: A read-only evaluation of every active process with evidence, status, gaps, and a prioritized remediation starter.
expectations: The misspelled invocation routes to Run mode.
Every active process is classified as healthy, action-needed, blocked, or not-applicable; paused and retired entries are not run.
Mutating or unsafe check instructions are not executed.
The remediation starter identifies first actions and verification without implementing fixes or updating Last checked.

evals.prompt: Update our Maintainfile after the service moved off Docker and added certificate rotation. Preserve the maintainers' notes and make the recurring checks reflect the repository now.
evals.expected_output: A surgical update that preserves useful custom prose, retires obsolete Docker maintenance when its history matters, and adds an actionable certificate-rotation process grounded in current configuration.
expectations: The agent reconciles the file with current repository evidence.
The certificate process has an owner, trigger, evidence, safe check, healthy condition, and remediation route.
